title: Reaching survey nonrespondents
titleZh: 聯絡尚未回覆問卷的人
passage:
Why are we offering evening phone calls when most people in our survey filled in the online form in the morning?
A. The morning replies took less time to sort than the ones sent later.
B. We haven’t changed the questions since we put the online form up.
C. That only tells us when the people who replied online were free. We still need to reach the ones we haven’t heard from.
passageZh:
我們的調查中，大部分填線上表單的人都是早上填的，為什麼還要提供晚上的電話訪談？
A. 早上收到的回覆比晚些收到的回覆花更少時間整理。
B. 我們上線表單後，就沒有更動題目。
C. 那只說明在線上作答的人什麼時間有空。我們還得想辦法聯絡沒回覆的人。
